gaps: Dates: 'date' is the poll release date when stated; otherwise the publication date of the cited story (noted in week/notes).

Pre-2006 NAIA era (both sports) not covered: Biola's online story archive starts 2006 and NAIA poll releases before ~2006 were not found online (NAIA.org old release URLs now 404; naia.prestosports.com blocked by Cloudflare).

NAIA weekly polls are incomplete: data comes from VSN reprints (not every edition reprinted) plus Biola story mentions. Missing editions include most 2006-2008 weekly polls, 2012 in-season (Biola appears unranked after preseason No. 10), and most 2016 softball editions (final 2016 rank unknown).
2007 baseball and softball NAIA ranks come only from Biola story mentions (no poll documents); 2007 baseball final was unranked (per 2008 preseason 'previous' column).

NAIA softball 2012-2013, 2017 and NAIA baseball 2013-2016: no ranking or receiving-votes evidence found (Biola stories say softball was unranked early 2011 to March 2014 and baseball unranked Nov 2011 to April 2017).

NCBWA DII national poll only verified via the sportswriters.net archive for 2018-2022 (Biola appears only in 2020). The 2023-2026 NCBWA DII national polls were not systematically checked beyond Biola/PacWest stories (none mention a Biola national ranking).

NCBWA / D2SIDA DII West Region baseball polls: no primary documents found; rows rely on Biola stories and one PacWest release. Poll name for the 2020 regional poll is ambiguous (Biola attributes it to the NCBWA office).
ABCA/Rawlings DII coaches poll, Collegiate Baseball DII poll and D1Baseball DII rankings: no Biola appearances found. The Collegiate Baseball 2020 in-season DII polls were not located online.

NCAA DII official regional rankings: 2021 first ranking, 2022 third/final ranking and 2023 final ranking positions for Biola softball are unknown. No evidence that Biola baseball appeared in NCAA DII West regional rankings (PacWest releases 2022-2026 list none).
NFCA DII polls 2020 (COVID-shortened), 2023, 2024, 2025: Biola not listed in any edition, including receiving votes (all editions crawled).
NCCAA rankings (2017-18 and 2018-19 dual membership): only two isolated mentions found; the full NCCAA weekly rankings were not located.
NAIA regional polls (for example the 2008 Region II softball poll) are only known from single story mentions.
